architecture_summary.engine_rationale: Direct, zero-video YouTube extraction in native Java/Kotlin without external Python runtime or Termux dependencies. Far superior start latency and minimal footprint compared to youtubedl-android wrappers.
architecture_summary.offline_storage: AndroidX Media3 DownloadManager + SimpleCache with local Room DB metadata
architecture_summary.local_subscription_storage: AndroidX Room (SQLite) with channel ID, name, avatar, and last sync timestamp
architecture_summary.ui_framework: Jetpack Compose with Material 3 & strict Screen Reader Accessibility (TalkBack/Jieshuo contentDescription + liveRegion)
architecture_summary.standalone_guarantee: 100% On-device execution, zero intermediate backend server, zero Termux dependencies, works entirely as an independent APK.

gradle_dependencies.purpose: Pure YouTube stream & channel metadata extraction
Audio stream playback and background caching
System notification playback controls & lockscreen integration
Local database for bookmarks, playback resumption, subscriptions

playback_resumption: suspend fun savePlaybackPosition(videoId: String, positionMs: Long, durationMs: Long)
download_manager: fun downloadAudio(videoId: String, title: String, streamUrl: String)
subscription_manager: suspend fun subscribe(channelId: String, name: String, avatarUrl: String)

accessibility_invariants.screen_reader_standards: WCAG 2.2 Level AA / Android Accessibility guidelines
accessibility_invariants.talkback_csr_optimization: Explicit contentDescription on all icon buttons; aria/traversal index; semantic state descriptions for playing/paused and download progress without emoji noise.
